extras: Runs a local HTTP server to host the ICS feed.
intentEvidence: This is an Obsidian plugin that synchronizes content from Obsidian's diary system to the system calendar application
problem: Diary entries stored in Obsidian are not automatically visible or accessible within standard system calendar applications.
summary: Diary ICS synchronizes Obsidian's diary notes into an ICS format, allowing system calendars to subscribe to the content.
